_comment: Film 49 Mirelo SFX 2.0 (mirelo-ai/sfx2.0/text-to-audio, 0.01 USD/s, 2 samples x 3 s, 2026-11-23; sample 2 = seed 4902 used, sample 1 had a late harsh transient). Files in /tmp/claude-0/f49/audio/sfx, not in the repo. step5..step1 = the step tone pitched -3, -1, +1, +2, +4 semitones (ffmpeg asetrate): the countdown climbs the stair, one brighter tone per year (step5 on 'Five years to go.' ... step1 on 'One year to go.'). Bed: sfx-bibliothek atmo/nightsky (hook only).

steptone.negative_prompt: music, melody, voices, drums, whoosh, noise, hiss, multiple notes
steptone.prompt: A single soft, bright glass bell tone as a glowing stair step lights up at night: one clean warm chime with a gentle shimmer and a slow airy decay, like a crystal glass struck softly with a felt mallet. Close, clean, quiet, calm and hopeful, no music, no voices.

make_steps: for n in 5:-3 4:-1 3:1 2:2 1:4; do k=${n%%:*}; s=${n##*:}; r=$(python3 -c "print(round(48000*2**($s/12)))"); ffmpeg -nostdin -v error -y -i step_b.mp3 -af "aresample=48000,asetrate=$r,aresample=48000,afade=t=out:st=2.2:d=0.6" -c:a libmp3lame -b:a 192k step$k.mp3; done
